name: grafana
title: Grafana
description: Your Grafana dashboards, alerts and Prometheus queries from the panel, with a bar item that counts what is firing. Silence an alert for an hour or a day without opening the browser.
author: pal

settings.label: URL
settings.description: Where Grafana answers, scheme included; no trailing slash needed.

settings.label: Token
settings.description: A service account token (Administration › Service accounts): Viewer reads everything here, Editor is needed to silence alerts. Stored as a keychain: or env: reference.

settings.label: Time range
settings.description: Appended to a dashboard's URL as from=…&to=now when set (now-6h, now-24h, now-7d); leave empty to open the dashboard's own range.

settings.label: Prometheus datasource
settings.description: The datasource the Query palette runs against, by uid or name; leave empty for Grafana's default.

settings.label: Saved queries
settings.description: PromQL listed before you type in the Query palette, one `Name = expr` per line (cmd+s on a result saves the one you ran).

settings.label: Panels in the pane
settings.description: How many of a dashboard's time series panels the detail pane draws: as panel images when the image renderer plugin is installed, else as sparklines from the panels' queries. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Timeout
settings.description: How long one request may take before the row says Grafana did not answer.

grafana.title: Grafana Dashboards
grafana.description: Every dashboard, starred first, with its folder and tags; Enter opens it in the browser with the time range you set, cmd+enter asks for one. Folders as a filter that lists them, each a drill-in.

keys.title: Open the dashboard in the browser (with the `time_range` setting appended)
Open with a time range: from, to and kiosk asked in a form
Star or unstar (the token's own stars, which sort first here)
Open in kiosk mode (no chrome, for a wall)
The dashboard's folder as a level

alerts.title: Grafana Alerts
alerts.description: Every alert instance firing or pending, by rule, with its summary, severity, labels and since when; silences as a filter, with the active silences to expire.

keys.title: Silence this instance for 1 hour (asks first)
Expire the silence on a silenced instance, or a silence row (asks first)

query.title: Grafana Query
query.description: A PromQL instant query against the Prometheus datasource, one row per series with its value; the saved queries before you type. Enter copies the value, cmd+o opens Explore.

keys.title: Copy the value (on a saved query: run it)
Copy the series with its value
Copy every series with its value
Save the expression under a name (the `queries` setting)

query.description: Open the Query palette with an expression typed

open.description: Open a dashboard in the browser

from.description: A time range start (now-6h, an ISO date); the `time_range` setting when absent

pending.description: Alert instances pending (over the threshold, inside their `for`)

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: How many alert instances are firing (red) and pending (amber); hidden while none is, by its rules. The popover lists them by state: Enter opens the rule, o the dashboard, s silences for an hour (f four, d a day), c copies the summary.

empty.tooltip: No alert is firing on Grafana

rules.description: Nothing firing or pending: nothing to say.
Something is over its threshold but inside its `for`.

keys.title: Open the focused rule in Grafana
Open its dashboard (the alert list without one)
Silence the focused instance for 1 hour (asks first); on a silenced one, expire the silence
Open the alert list in Grafana
Move between alerts (or j and k)
